description: Run the wiki quality eval harness. fast suite checks health and citation coverage without LLM calls. full suite also LLM-judges a sample of citations (requires an LLM provider). Set record: true to append results to eval history (default false — read-only).

record.description: Append results to eval history (default false; set true to persist a checkpoint)

sampleSize.description: Citations to sample for citation support (full suite only, default 20)

suite.description: fast=no LLM calls, full=includes citation support (requires LLM provider)

name: run_eval
title: Run Eval
